articles.author: Ted Hesson, Lauren Kaori Gurley
articles.title: Trump administration proposes $103,000 fee for H-1B visas after legal setback - The Washington Post
articles.description: The president contends the program to hire skilled foreign workers has been used to take jobs away from Americans. A judge struck down a previous attempt to implement a similar fee.
articles.content:
The Trump administration plans to charge employers seeking skilled foreign workers through the H-1B visa program a $103,265 fee, a proposed regulation posted on Monday says.
